Share on X Telegram Armed bandits have reportedly attacked Lumma Sanke in Borgu Local Government Area of Niger State, setting homes, shops and other properties ablaze and displacing several residents.
The attack reportedly occurred on Friday evening, November 27, with local accounts and videos circulating from the area indicating that the attackers targeted Kambari families.
Several families, including women and children, were said to have fled their homes after properties were set on fire, leaving many residents displaced.
The incident comes days after a deadly attack on neighbouring Lumma Ba’are on November 21, during which several residents, including the village head, Mallam Bawa Muhammad, were reportedly killed.
The latest attack has raised further concerns over the security situation in communities across the Borgu axis, with residents calling for urgent intervention by security agencies.
As of press time, there was no official statement on the latest incident from the Niger State Police Command or other security agencies.
